name: 陳匡正
objective:
Trademark Act is formulated to safeguard trademark rights and consumers' interest, maintain fair competitions of markets, and facilitate normal development of industries and commerce. A trademark may be composed of a word, design, symbol, color, sound, three-dimensional shape or a combination thereof. A trademark as defined above shall be distinctive enough for relevant consumers of the goods or services to recognize it as identification to those goods or services and to differentiate such goods or services from those offered by others. A person who wishes to obtain trademark rights in order to distinguish its goods or services shall apply for trademark registration as provided under this Act. The discussion in the course covers theory and examples to enhance a deeper understanding of Trademark Act for the students. In fact, the class lectures will be in English 20% and in Chinese 80%, and the class materials are cases in Chinese.

商標法係為保障商標權及消費者利益，維護市場公平競爭，促進工商企業正常發展所制定之法律。商標得以文字、圖形、記號、顏色、聲音、 立體形狀或其聯合式所組成，並應足以使商品或服務之相關消費者認識其為表彰商品或服務之標識，藉以與他人之商品或服務相區別。凡因表 彰自己之商品或服務，欲取得商標權者，應依該法申請註冊。本課程將兼顧實例與理論進行探討，來深化同學對於商標法的瞭解。事實上，本課程之進行，20% 以英文講授、80% 以中文講授，而且課堂教材以中文案例為主。
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1 (2026/9/7~2026/9/12) Case Studies of Trademark Use about Keyword Advertising (I)
Week 2 (2026/9/14~2026/9/19) Case Studies of Trademark Use about Keyword Advertising (II)
Week 3 (2026/9/21~2026/9/26) Case Studies of Trademark Use about Gift (I)
Week 4 (2026/9/28~2026/10/3) Case Studies of Trademark Use about Gift (II)
Week 5 (2026/10/5~2026/10/10) Case Studies about Judging Trademark Likelihood of Confusion (I)
Week 6 (2026/10/12~2026/10/17) Case Studies about Judging Trademark Likelihood of Confusion (II)
Week 7 (2026/10/19~2026/10/24) Case Studies of Descriptive Mark
Week 8 (2026/10/26~2026/10/31) Case Studies about Name Trademark and Personality Right Protection
Week 9 (2026/11/2~2026/11/7) Case Studies about Protection of Well-Known Trademark (I)
Week 10 (2026/11/9~2026/11/14) Case Studies about Protection of Well-Known Trademark (II) 
Week 11 (2026/11/16~2026/11/21) Case Studies about Parallel Importation and Trademark Infringement
Week 12 (2026/11/23~2026/11/28) Case Studies about Trademark Exhaustion Doctrine and Parallel Importation of Genuine Goods
Week 13 (2026/11/30~2026/12/5) Case Studies about Trademark Bona Fide Use; Case Studies about Fair Use of Geographical Name Trademark
Week 14 (2026/12/7~2025/12/12) Case Studies about Judging Fair Use of Trademark Parody; Conclusions
Week 15 (2026/12/14~2026/12/19) Final Project Report (I)
Week 16 (2026/12/21~2026/12/26) Final Project Report (II)
